statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2024-0384 is an informational notice that the instant crate is unmaintained and identifies no patched release. Milvus 2.6.23 includes it through measure_time in the legacy Tantivy fork used for V5 index compatibility; migrating that fork to std::time remains under evaluation. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2024-0384.html
